lines.en: Sade, you look tired. Did you have the car repaired yesterday, or did you fix it yourself?
lines.pt: Sade, você parece cansada. Você mandou consertar o carro ontem, ou consertou você mesma?

lines.en: We had it repaired at the garage. The mechanic said the brakes needed attention, and we had them checked too.
lines.pt: Mandamos consertar na oficina. O mecânico disse que os freios precisavam de atenção, e mandamos revisá-los também.

lines.en: Smart. We’re having our roof inspected next week, and we are going to have the gutters cleaned as well.
lines.pt: Esperto. Vamos mandar inspecionar o telhado na semana que vem, e vamos mandar limpar também as calhas.

lines.en: How much does it cost to have a roof checked here? Last year I had my windows replaced, and it was expensive.
lines.pt: Quanto custa mandar verificar um telhado aqui? No ano passado mandei trocar minhas janelas, e foi caro.

lines.en: About two hundred dollars. I had it done by a friend’s company, so I paid less than the normal price.
lines.pt: Cerca de duzentos dólares. Mandei fazer por uma empresa de um amigo, então paguei menos que o preço normal.

lines.en: Lucky you. I usually have my taxes done by an accountant, but this year I’m doing them myself.
lines.pt: Sorte sua. Costumo mandar fazer meus impostos por um contador, mas este ano estou fazendo eu mesma.

lines.en: Brave! My husband had his phone repaired last month, but they broke the screen again, so he had it replaced.
lines.pt: Corajosa! Meu marido mandou consertar o celular no mês passado, mas quebraram a tela de novo, então ele mandou trocar.

lines.en: That’s annoying. Did the shop give him a guarantee, or did he have to pay again?
lines.pt: Que chato. A loja deu garantia a ele, ou ele teve que pagar de novo?

lines.en: They gave him a guarantee, so he had the screen replaced for free. It took only two days.
lines.pt: Deram garantia, então ele mandou trocar a tela de graça. Levou só dois dias.

lines.en: Good. Next week I’m having the kitchen painted, and I need to have my passport photo taken as well.
lines.pt: Bom. Na semana que vem vou mandar pintar a cozinha, e preciso tirar a foto do passaporte também.

lines.en: We should plan a day together and have everything done. Then we can relax and have lunch.
lines.pt: Deveríamos combinar um dia e resolver tudo. Depois podemos relaxar e almoçar.

facts.label: Causativo have something done
facts.sub: Use quando outra pessoa faz o serviço. Passado: had my car repaired. Presente contínuo: am having it checked. Futuro: I’m going to have it done.

facts.label: have, had, am having
facts.sub: Mude have para o tempo certo: I have my taxes done every year. I had my roof inspected last week. I’m having the kitchen painted on Monday. O particípio não muda.

facts.label: Did you have…done?
facts.sub: Na pergunta, use do / does / did + have: Did you have your windows replaced? Where do you have your hair cut? Responda: Yes, I did. / At a salon in town.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “I had my car repaired” means a mechanic repaired it.
“I repaired my car” and “I had my car repaired” mean the same.
items.why: In the second, someone else did it.

items.s: We say “I had repaired my car” for services.
items.why: We say I had my car repaired.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “I had my car repaired” means a mechanic repaired it. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
“I repaired my car” and “I had my car repaired” mean the same. → Falso (In the second, someone else did it.)
We say “I had repaired my car” for services. → Falso (We say I had my car repaired.)

pages.title: Errands on a rainy day · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Thursday in Vancouver. Gwen waits in a café near the harbour. Her friend Sade arrives with many bags. She has spent the whole morning running errands. Their cars, their houses and their phones all need work. They compare what has been done and what has not.

“Sade, you look tired. Did you have the car repaired yesterday, or did you fix it yourself?” says Gwen. “We had it repaired at the garage. The mechanic said the brakes needed attention, and we had them checked too.” says Sade. “Smart. We’re having our roof inspected next week, and we are going to have the gutters cleaned as well.” says Gwen.
